title: The crash that doesn't wait: what daily candles hid
dek: October 2025's ten-minute Coinbase hole, the monthly candle that hid it, and the $82–83k box with fading ETF impulse through 29 September 2026.
thesis: The setup can take months. The event may take hours. $82–83k has held twice. This is a hypothesis about speed, not a crash forecast.
stakes: ETF inflows are still green and no longer accelerating. Yields are the hostile tape. Next evidence is a reclaim of $86k — or a close through $82k, possibly through several gates at once.
subscribeHook: If several doors fail in one session — or $86k is reclaimed — the letter updates the sequence. Charts stay free here; the call moves by email.
sourceNote: Issue 28 charts use Coinbase Exchange UTC candles (5-minute 10 Oct 2025; daily October 2025; daily 15–29 Sep 2026) and Farside Investors US-session ETF flows. Weekend blanks are not zeroes. 30 September 2026 is a partial UTC day and is not plotted as a completed close. Educational scenario research; no leverage.

briefs.headline: The $107,000 print lasted about a minute
briefs.lede: Coinbase's 21:00 UTC hour on 10 October 2025 opened $114,324 and closed $113,875. The $107,000 low lived inside that hour.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. The 1-minute low printed $107,000 at 21:26 UTC. By 21:30 the 5-minute bar was already recovering through $114,000. The daily candle closed $112,980.

Read. Daily and hourly closes hid a ten-minute liquidity hole. October 2025 is a mechanics reference, not a four-year-cycle bottom.

briefs.headline: October closed −4%. The month was not calm.
briefs.lede: From the 30 September close to the 31 October close, Bitcoin fell 4.0% while traveling 18% from the monthly high to the intra-month low.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. October 2025 Coinbase high $126,296 (6 Oct), 10 Oct low $107,000, 17 Oct low $103,517, month close $109,555.

Read. Monthly return does not measure tail risk. A later green October would not, by itself, falsify a compressed event inside the month.

briefs.headline: The door held again. The impulse faded.
briefs.lede: 28 September low $82,510, close $83,457. Farside +$31.0M then +$66.2M after the $999M impulse.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact. No completed close below $82k. No completed close above $86k since 22 September. ETF sign still green; daily prints have decayed to tens of millions.

Read. Gates are observation points, not scheduled stops. H-COMPRESSION is a speed hypothesis inside the structural path, not the base case.
